# Sombría

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [adrian](../lore/worlds/adrian.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `sombria`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Shallow epeiric shelves / silica-reef coastlines
- **Diet:** Benthic invertebrates / small scavengers
- **Active:** Nocturnal (haze thins, cooler, trace O2 pools form)
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Camouflaged silica-moss skin, venomous barbs, wide-angled binocular eyes, low-profile body

**Temperament:** Patient, solitary, highly aggressive when striking
